page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage or GPU hardware bundled with this instance, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers of compute and memory capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1099.38, and the multi-core score is 1456.5, both falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show 10.45 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 9.47 GB/sec for write operations. In database and application tests, the instance achieves 1.48 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 1.26 GB/sec.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but modest performance profile, the ecs.g5ne.large offers an entry-level hardware profile suitable for lightweight workloads. The lack of local storage and low memory bandwidth make it less suitable for intensive database operations or heavy data processing. It is best utilized for low-traffic web serving, basic application hosting, lightweight background tasks, and development or testing environments that require dedicated CPU resources without high computational demands.
